sanity: upstream golden sanity: 16 numbers, 11 strings, ordered duplicate control passed

lossless-spelling.paragraph: json.parse takes a UTF-8 String and returns an owned tree, keeping validated decimal number lexemes exactly.
lossless-spelling.adaptation: RawValue spans retain the token spelling; Number formatting is raw upstream evidence only.

duplicate-decoded-key.paragraph: rejects duplicate decoded object keys and preserves insertion order; DuplicateKey points at the repeated key opening quote.
duplicate-decoded-key.adaptation: Ordered pairs visitor classifies duplicates independently, overriding upstream last-wins.

syntax-byte-offset.paragraph: Syntax, DuplicateKey and parser Nesting payloads are zero-based byte offsets into the input; end of input is its byte length.
syntax-byte-offset.adaptation: Mutations replace one token with ? or append #; byte offsets derive from the edit position. Fixed escape rows use the first invalid escape byte per lexical contract.

hirsel-depth-boundary.paragraph: MAX_NESTING: u64 = 128 counts open arrays and objects, scalars using no level; opening container 129 is Nesting. Writing uses the same nesting bound, returning Nesting(128) at the attempted container depth.
hirsel-depth-boundary.adaptation: Three independently constructed depth chains; upstream default recursion refusal is retained separately.

public-number-validation.paragraph: Both validate every Number against the decimal grammar, requiring complete consumption, and return InvalidNumber otherwise; stringify_into keeps existing content and may leave a written prefix on error.
public-number-validation.adaptation: Grammar fullmatch selects validity; preceding array element and comma remain in the output prefix.

shared-domain.paragraph: preserves insertion order; escape ASCII controls, quotes and backslashes, and leave other scalars unescaped.
shared-domain.adaptation: Ordered visitor provides direct host-built trees; string escaping uses serde_json.
